every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 keeps the left-hand narrative card pinned across every step (frames 4 and 7), whereas Site 2 drops the text card completely during transitions in frames 4 and 7, leaving an awkward empty void on the left.

explains_the_project.reason: Because Site 1 maintains its explanatory card alongside the 3D press and caliper animations in frames 4 and 7, the visitor can always read what the machine is doing, whereas Site 2 loses the explanation mid-scroll in frames 4 and 7.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the exact same 3D industrial assembly line, materials, lighting, and grounded grid across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Both sites share the same typography and card design, though Site 1 keeps the layout consistent in frames 4 and 7 instead of letting the text panel vanish.

overall.reason: While both sites share an identical 3D scene and visual design, Site 1 keeps its explanatory text card consistently present across every scroll position rather than dropping out into empty space during transitions.
